spanish: Y fundirás a ella cuatro anillos de oro, y los darás sobre sus cuatro pies; y dos anillos sobre su costado el uno, y dos anillos sobre su costado el segundo.

findings.issue: Unmarked supplied object pronoun. The qal 2ms verb has no object suffix and no object token.
Suffix is 3rd masculine singular; ella is feminine. Same referent, with Spanish gender smoothing.

notes: Qal 2ms futures, four gold rings, placement upon four feet, and one side versus the second side match the tokens.
